title: HECM Modified Plan Designation: Property Tax Bill Held in the Line
content:
**Clause.** Added to the amounts kept in the line when the designated amount of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) Modified plan is set is the next property tax bill:

- when Cedarline advanced property tax on the loan — a property tax advance in the borrower's Property Charge Advance Repayment records — on a payment date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date, the total of the property tax advanced in that window;
- when no property tax was advanced in that window but a set-aside on the loan (Set-Aside Accounts) is depleted with an annual property tax above 0.00, that annual property tax;
- otherwise nothing.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical handling date 1 September).**

| Records | Judgement | Amount held |
|---|---|---|
| property tax advanced on 2 September last year, 1750.00 | inside the window | 1750.00 |
| property tax advanced on 1 September last year only; depleted set-aside with annual property tax 2200.00 | advance outside the window; set-aside applies | 2200.00 |
| no advance in the window; no depleted set-aside | neither branch | nothing |
